mistakeTypes.name: Sign/Direction Confusion
mistakeTypes.description: Errors related to incorrect sign conventions or direction assignments in vectors and components.
mistakeTypes.remediation: Practice: Always draw axes first, label positive directions, and check sign at every step.

mistakeTypes.name: Sin/Cos Component Swap
mistakeTypes.description: Mixing up sine and cosine when decomposing forces on inclines or at angles.
mistakeTypes.remediation: Remember: Component along the angle uses cos, component perpendicular uses sin. Or use the 'adjacent = cos' rule.

mistakeTypes.name: Reference Frame Mixing
mistakeTypes.description: Using quantities from different reference frames in the same equation without proper transformation.
mistakeTypes.remediation: Commit to ONE frame at the start. If switching, explicitly transform all quantities.

mistakeTypes.name: Missed Constraint
mistakeTypes.description: Failing to use a stated constraint (e.g., string is inextensible, rolling without slipping).
mistakeTypes.remediation: Underline all constraint keywords in the problem. Each constraint gives you an equation.

mistakeTypes.name: Invalid Conservation Application
mistakeTypes.description: Applying conservation laws when the required conditions are not met (e.g., energy with friction).
mistakeTypes.remediation: Before applying conservation, explicitly verify: Is the system isolated? Is work by non-conservative forces zero?

mistakeTypes.name: Revealed Without Trying
mistakeTypes.description: User revealed the answer or entered read-only mode without making a genuine attempt.
mistakeTypes.remediation: Try writing ANY approach before revealing. Even wrong attempts build understanding.

mistakeTypes.name: Hint-Dependent Solution
mistakeTypes.description: Needed multiple hints to arrive at the answer, indicating fragile understanding.
mistakeTypes.remediation: After solving with hints, close them and try to reconstruct the approach from memory.

mistakeTypes.name: Algebraic Manipulation Error
mistakeTypes.description: Errors in mathematical manipulation: wrong expansion, incorrect simplification, etc.
mistakeTypes.remediation: Check algebra step-by-step. Use dimensional analysis to catch errors.

mistakeTypes.name: Unit Inconsistency
mistakeTypes.description: Mixing units or forgetting to convert before calculation.
mistakeTypes.remediation: Convert ALL quantities to SI units BEFORE calculating. Write units with every number.

mistakeTypes.name: Conceptual Confusion
mistakeTypes.description: Mixing up related but distinct concepts (e.g., displacement vs distance, normal force vs weight).
mistakeTypes.remediation: Review the definitions carefully. Create a comparison table for commonly confused concepts.
